description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA). This is an excellent opportunity for a COTA seeking a stable and rewarding full-time position.

We are looking for a passionate COTA to contribute to patient recovery and well-being. The role offers competitive hourly compensation, ranging from $28.00 to $37.00, based on your experience and qualifications.

If you are a motivated COTA ready to make a significant impact in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Current state licensure as a COTA in Florida
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
